### Nippon India Growth Mid Cap Fund -- Nippon-FS-AUGUST-2026.pdf -- page 9 (details as on July 31, 2026; volatility measures)
Nippon India Growth Mid Cap Fund 
Mid Cap Fund 
Details as on July 31, 2026 
Type of Scheme 
Mid   Cap   Fund   - An   open   ended   equity   scheme   predominantly
investing in mid cap stocks. 
Current Investment Philosophy 
The fund endeavors to invest in mid cap companies that have the
potential   to   substantially   increase   their   pro fi tability   and   have
consistent track record. The fund focuses on identifying potential
market leaders at an early stage with a view to create long term
alpha. The fund attempts to identify growth stocks that are available
at reasonable valuation, thus adopting a GARP (Growth at Reasonable
Price) style for investing. 
Date of Allotment 
October 08, 1995 
Fund Manager(s) 
Rupesh Patel (Managing Since Jan 2023)
